visualCharacteristics: Full-width photo background banner, left-aligned white heading, short text and red pill CTA; mid/bottom-of-page promo.
contentPattern: Photo background banner with heading, text and CTA: a hero; photo background belongs to the block, section not colored.
usage: Full-width photo background banner with heading, short text and a CTA, used for promotional bands.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-backed promo banners anywhere on the page. For a video background use hero-video.

cells: Background image (optional; for background-video heroes use the poster image and keep the Vimeo URL as a link in the text cell)
Rich text: title (heading), subheading/paragraph, CTA link
